name: minimap
description: The radar of the HUD: a slowly turning city map with a GPS route, blips and the player arrow, and up to three bars below it like health, armor and special ability. A bar flashes red above the alert threshold.

config.name: shape
config.label: Shape
config.description: A rounded rectangle that fills the widget, or a circle

config.name: rotation_speed
config.label: Rotation Speed
config.description: How fast the map turns, in degrees per second. 0 keeps it still

config.name: hide_route
config.label: Hide GPS Route
config.description: Hides the route to the waypoint

config.name: hide_blips
config.label: Hide Blips
config.description: Hides the colored dots on the map

config.name: health_metric
config.label: Health
config.description: The metric of the first bar, e.g. CPU utilization

config.name: health_color
config.label: Color
config.description: The color of the first bar. Defaults to green

config.name: armor_metric
config.label: Armor
config.description: The metric of the second bar, e.g. GPU utilization

config.name: armor_color
config.label: Color
config.description: The color of the second bar. Defaults to blue

config.name: special_metric
config.label: Special
config.description: The metric of the third bar, e.g. memory utilization

config.name: special_color
config.label: Color
config.description: The color of the third bar. Defaults to yellow

config.name: bar_height
config.label: Bar Height (%)
config.description: The height of the bars as a percentage of the widget height

config.name: alert_threshold
config.label: Alert Threshold (%)
config.description: Percentage of the max value from which a bar flashes red. 0 turns it off. Only percentages, °C and metrics with a known max value raise the alert
